_comment: Insight nodes for NPC name reveals. Per the locked doctrine (see docs/design/insight_revelation_system.md *Implementation status*), the name reveal fires on the ACT that proves the NPC is what they are -- not the first dialog open. For the Guide, that act is the Signing: him doing the thing he was sent to do is the moment the Vagrant understands 'this is the Guide.' The HP-bar / dialog speaker flip to 'Guide' the same frame the picker closes.

knows_guide._comment: Fires on signing_committed. The Signing IS the guidance -- naming happens through act, not interaction. Before commit, he is a stranger with words.
